purpose: Canonical data semantics for vendor evaluation and implementation

target_platform.supported_major_policy: Qualify PostgreSQL 17 for the first implementation release, exercise PostgreSQL 16 as the supported predecessor upgrade path, and retain PostgreSQL 18 as forward-compatibility rehearsal evidence.
target_platform.digest_storage: one SHA-256 semantic value represented as exactly 32-byte bytea or constrained lowercase 64-character hexadecimal text with algorithm canonicalization schema and scope metadata
target_platform.decimal_envelope: numeric(38,18) with narrower effective precision and scale selected by the versioned assay analyte and method profile

primitive_policies.storage: timestamptz for instants; date for calendar dates; original source representation in a separate provenance field when source-clock meaning matters
validation: Every instant carries an explicit offset at ingress and normalizes to UTC.
Equivalent instants share one canonical representation and digest.
Business occurrence time and server recording time remain distinct.
Precision and source clock quality are explicit.

primitive_policies.storage: uuid for internal identity; constrained text for tenant-source-external identity
validation: Internal and external identities use distinct value types.
External identity includes tenant and source namespace.
Whitespace, length, normalization, and collation policy are explicit.
Actor identity retains issuer and authenticated subject context.

primitive_policies.storage: one SHA-256 semantic value represented as exactly 32-byte bytea or constrained lowercase 64-character hexadecimal text with algorithm canonicalization version schema version and content scope
validation: Digest length and algorithm are enforced.
The canonicalization profile and schema version participate in the evidence envelope.
Raw-byte and semantic-content digests remain distinguishable.
Bytea and hexadecimal representations round-trip without information loss and compare through one canonical lowercase hexadecimal projection.

primitive_policies.storage: finite numeric(38,18) maximum envelope with effective precision and scale selected by a versioned assay analyte and method specification
validation: Raw and canonical values remain linked.
Finite decimal, precision, scale, qualifier, reference range, and detection limits are explicit.
Analyte, method revision, and unit compatibility are validated.
Conversion provenance records source and canonical values.
The bound profile records effective precision scale range qualifier vocabulary reference interval detection limits and rounding policy.

primitive_policies.storage: versioned UCUM code plus original source unit mapping revision conversion contract digest and rounding policy
validation: Unit mapping is assay and analyte aware.
Conversion factors and rounding policy are versioned.
Unmapped source units enter an owned exception route.
Every released conversion binds analyte assay method revision source artifact and occurrence and recording instants.

primitive_policies.storage: named checks for stable operational states and versioned reference relations for evolving scientific or regulatory codes
validation: Every code resolves to one vocabulary and version.
Source and canonical codes remain linked.
State transitions use an explicit transition contract.

primitive_policies.storage: jsonb for queryable versioned objects; content-addressed raw bytes for byte fidelity
validation: Decoding rejects duplicate keys, non-finite numbers, unsupported depth, and unsupported size.
Every envelope carries a schema identity and version.
Canonical JSON uses explicit domain encoders and Unicode policy.
Raw vendor payload access follows classification, encryption, and retention policy.

primitive_policies.storage: named table checks or state-specific relations selected by historical and query needs
validation: Every nullable field has a documented semantic state.
Status-dependent evidence fields form one valid combination.
Quarantined, delivered, released, superseded, and expired states carry the data required to explain that state.
Discriminated unions and database checks keep state-specific fields coherent.

primitive_policies.storage: tenant identity plus composite tenant-preserving keys and forced row-level security
validation: Authenticated context establishes one tenant scope.
Every tenant-owned relation carries tenant identity and composite referential integrity.
Default-deny row policies govern reads and writes.
Evaluation records declare tenant or deliberately de-identified program scope.

primitive_policies.storage: append-only domain-event relations with versioned envelopes
validation: Business and recording time, authenticated actor, causality, schema version, and payload digest remain linked.
Corrections supersede prior meaning while preserving the original event.
Current projections reconstruct from released domain events and snapshots.
Application roles write through controlled version-guarded boundaries.

primitive_policies.storage: durable idempotency records, inbox arrivals, and a transactional outbox published through the Debezium Outbox Event Router
validation: Idempotency binds tenant, operation scope, stable key, canonical request digest, and original result.
Every arrival receives one ingress identity independent of extracted vendor identity.
Aggregate state, event, and outbox message commit through one transaction boundary.
Debezium owns change-data capture and event routing; the application owns event meaning, idempotent consumers, and observable publication lag.

primitive_policies.storage: versioned evaluation record, typed source lineage, and governed raw-artifact locator
validation: Record schema, serialization, persistence, and comparison report share one compatible contract.
Typed edges preserve asserted evidence relationships and source identity.
Environment, collection method, observation time, and data classification remain explicit.
Raw regulated or sensitive evidence remains in governed storage while the repository carries a redacted locator.

primitive_policies.storage: workload-derived indexes and measured partition boundaries
validation: Every qualified query has a representative plan and performance objective.
Partial work indexes serve pending inbox and outbox states.
Retention and archival keys preserve tenant, time, and evidence meaning.
Partitioning begins when measured volume and maintenance objectives justify it.

entity_bindings.system_of_record: relational location projection and immutable transfer event
relational observation plus content-addressed raw artifact
object storage plus relational metadata and lineage
Flyway-managed flyway_schema_history plus immutable versioned SQL
caller-supplied comparison record plus governed raw-artifact locator

metadata.next_review_trigger: A supported database major, scientific unit policy, canonicalization profile, or qualified entity mapping changes.
